scope: Optional labelled saved-selected table columns over fixed pure cached statistics; no live/pane equivalence

root_policy.default_visibility: hidden in both panes; reset restores hidden state
root_policy.inputs: Only current cached size, RAW saved completedbytes and current cached fixed DND facts; no previous/fallback/live values
root_policy.done_display: integer permille rendered with one decimal; numeric sorting by integer permille
root_policy.unknown: em dash display/accessibility and invalid numeric sort role
root_policy.snapshots: Replace/clear saved-selected fields independently on every snapshot; telemetry/details leave them unchanged
root_policy.validation: Reject presentation before mutation for negative saved size/remaining, remaining above known size or permille outside0..1000
root_policy.unchanged: Logical0–9, Name default sort, full Progress/Size, completion panes, target identity and actions
root_policy.tooltip: Saved snapshot of selected files excluding skipped files, with unavailable/inconsistent values explicit

source_semantics.fact: Manager Size reads selected remaining first then selected size. Its sort key is size, remaining (unless simple sort), second-line state. Metadata download subsequently becomes sort−1/blank. Size formatting can be custom/localized and show a second line; none of that is a plain saved scalar equality claim.

Manager Remaining checks metadata first, then reads selected remaining; negative values keep their numeric sort key but display blank. The accepted native normal domain instead publishes an unknown diagnostic for invalid tuples.

Manager Done uses stats selected permille and does not apply the Size/Remaining metadata suppression. File Done uses separate wrapped-long multiply/divide/narrowing. Original percentage rendering uses locale percentage_format(thousands/1000.0); fixed one-decimal native text is an adaptation.

Original fallback defaults show Size in both panes and Done only incomplete; Remaining appears in neither default array. Existing saved column settings and force-visible flags can override fallback visibility. Original fallback sort is Rank ascending; native currently sorts Name ascending and keeps that behavior.

Selected Done1000 and no-DiskManager cached candidates do not establish retained assumedComplete or original DND preference pane routing. Keep current native CompletionRole based on full bytes/completed unchanged and do not call it original pane parity.

limitations: Actual independent original helper observations and comparison are pending; copied expressions/tests are not original runtime equality.
Metadata-download attrs.flags and suppression are outside first facts API; do not identify these labelled saved columns as complete original live Size/Remaining semantics.
Public assumedComplete lifecycle and DND Always In Incomplete preference remain separate from selected Done/cached controller flags and unchanged native panes.

Original byte/custom/locale percentage formats, composite Size sort/second-line/tooltip behavior, persisted column settings, original Rank/default visibility and per-file Done are not implemented by this proposal.
The inventory/cache pair is an owned read observation, not proof of live atomicity, current payload verification or original state recovery.
